snippet.title: Death & Faeology - Official Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
In a world where the fae-touched fall prey to a sinister killer, only a faeologist can uncover the truth. A dark academia murder mystery narrative game inspired by Strange Horticulture and the Ace Attorney series.
Visit Steam to add Death & Faeology to your wishlist and download the demo!
